description: Reopen r-sort-3-keys-mdb read-only. On LK by IX_KN (K, N) and by IX_KND (K, N DESC), Seek with each of = >= > <= < and the K-only key for 11 K values (A253, A254, A255, A254B, e-acute127, e-acute128, e-acute255, sharp-s128, sharp-s255, han255, supplementary127), then on IX_KN the full keys (K, 1) and (K, 2) of e-acute255 and sharp-s255 with the same five operators, reading NoMatch and the current ID after each. Asks whether a partial key longer than 508 bytes is compared in the stored shortened form (its own digest against the entries' digests), and how each operator lands for it.
